tickerText: [TENNIS] Wednesday at Almaty sends Tsitsipas, Khachanov, Shimabukuro, Marozsan and Atmane through the round of 32 while Brussels third-round winners include Navone, Griekspoor and Struff; WTA Osaka crowns Talia Gibson and Ashlyn Krueger in early singles and Ningbo lines up Kostyuk–Alexandrova • [SQUASH] PSA Gold Silicon Valley Open hits Round of 16 Wednesday at Squash Zone in Redwood City with Diego Elias and Nour El Sherbini among the evening headliners on SquashTV after opening-day play • [BADMINTON] YONEX French Open day two in Paris sees home favorite Toma Junior Popov stun world No. 1 Kunlavut Vitidsarn 9-21, 21-14, 21-15 as An Se-young, Alex Lanier and Christo Popov headline the round-of-32 slate at Arena Grand Paris • [PICKLEBALL] Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam moves into round of 32 at Kai Tak Arena as Ben Johns and Anna Leigh Waters make their Hong Kong debuts and locals Nok Yiu Tang and Hong Kit Wong chase deep runs in the PPA Asia season finale • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent pivot to men’s and women’s team quarterfinals Wednesday—Hong Kong vs Chinese Taipei and Korea vs India in the morning, Singapore vs Japan and China vs Thailand in the women’s session—with singles and doubles brackets continuing alongside

newsItems.title: Popov Stuns Vitidsarn
newsItems.excerpt: Toma Junior Popov rallied past top seed Kunlavut Vitidsarn 9-21, 21-14, 21-15 in the YONEX French Open round of 32 at Arena Grand Paris, giving the home crowd a signature upset on day two of the Super 750.

newsItems.title: Johns and Waters Debut
newsItems.excerpt: The Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam reaches round of 32 at Kai Tak Arena with world No. 1s Ben Johns and Anna Leigh Waters stepping onto court Wednesday after locals Nok Yiu Tang and Hong Kit Wong opened the main draw with strong wins.

newsItems.title: Almaty and Brussels Roll On
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Almaty round-of-32 winners include Stefanos Tsitsipas, Karen Khachanov, Sho Shimabukuro and Fabian Marozsan, while Brussels third-round results feature Griekspoor, Struff and Navone; WTA Osaka early singles went to Talia Gibson and Ashlyn Krueger.

newsItems.title: Tashkent Team Quarterfinals
newsItems.excerpt: The 29th ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent shift focus to men’s and women’s team quarterfinals on Wednesday, opening with Hong Kong against Chinese Taipei and Korea versus India as singles and doubles draws continue through Oct. 25.
